QuestInfo.name: Investigate the Brawl 'n' Bash Club 1
QuestInfo.0: The #m940201000# has already been taken over by Mr. Hazard. Talk to #bHazard's Vile Crony#k who guards the door to gain entry.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Hazard's minion seems oblivious to your identity. For the low, low price of #b15 #t4036147#s#k, he'll let you inside. You can get them from #r#o2400307##k monsters in #b#m402000310##k.
QuestInfo.2: Your brought the #t4036147#s and can now move freely in and out of the club.

0.msg: Whadya want? There ain't no matches right now. Get lost.

1.msg: Ya better not be more troublemakers from Gen's branch.\r\n

2.msg: No. We're here for advance registration for the Coliseum Arena. I'm a stickler for getting things done early. Haha.

3.msg: Oh, that's all? There's a participation fee. It's 15 #i4036147:# #b#t4036147##k.\r\n

4.msg: And anyway, it's all to protect the competitors. Mr. Hazard's not that bad, really.\r\n

yes.0: You can get #i4036147:# #b#t4036147##k from those #r#o2400307#s#k over in #bStray Dog Alley#k. Should be easy for a couple o' tough guys like you, right?\r\n

no.0: And don't whine to me about price. It is what it is.\r\n

0.msg: Wow, 30 #i4036147:# #t4036147#! If that's not a mission accomplished, I don't know what is!\r\n

1.msg: Fair enough. Welcome to the competition. You may enter.\r\n

3.msg: We're in! But, I can't help wondering what they were going to do with those gross tails.\r\n

0.msg: I hate those slimy cronies of Mr. Hazard's, but I'll just have to pay them back later. I've got other things on my plate right now.

default.0: You can get #i4036147:# #bWriggling Tails#k off #rSpecter Stray Dogs#k over in #bStray Dog Alley#k. Should be easy for a couple o' tough guys like you, right?\r\n
